attribution: the Chief Electoral Officer's information, as reported
quote: As per the information shared by the Telangana Chief Electoral Office, hearings of 82,11,205 electors have been completed. Of these, 74,62,851 voters have been found eligible for inclusion in the final electoral publication as of Friday. A total of 12,969 electors have been found ineligible and they will be excluded from the final list. Among the notices served, 18,12,367 electors are yet to respond despite multiple reminders and house visits by the Booth Level Officers (BLOs). This comes even as the Election Commission of India (ECI) announced new measures such as doing away with in-person hearings and house-visits by the BLOs to collect documents and upload them on the ECINet. Except in circumstances, as decided by the ERO or AERO, hearings will be held, preferably online.
